note: Fixed questions for the tomato test. Each item names the lesson the answer must come from. A run passes when retrieval returns that lesson.

items.question: Umuseme w'inyanya umenyura ibyumweru binge mu ruseme?
Amazi y'inyanya agomba kujya ku mizi cyangwa ku mababi?
Kuki duhyigikira inyanya mu gihe cy'imvura?
Ni iki dukoresha mu gutwara inyanya, agaseke cyangwa umufuka?
Ni iki ngomba kubaza mbere yo kugura imbuto z'inyanya?
Inyanya ndende itandukaniye gute n'inyanya igufi?
